---
title: "Ship an Order"
description: "Mark a fulfillment as shipped and add tracking for the customer."
---

Once an order's items are fulfilled, you mark the fulfillment as shipped from the order's detail page. This tells the customer their items are on the way.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the orders list">
    Go to **Orders** in the sidebar. The page lists the orders that include your products. Select the order you want to work on.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/ship-an-order/step-1.png" alt="Open the orders list" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Open the order">
    Selecting a row opens the order's detail page, where you manage fulfillment, shipping, payments, and returns for your part of the order.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Review the order">
    The detail page shows the order's items, customer, payments, and fulfillment status. Work from here.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/ship-an-order/step-3.png" alt="Review the order" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Mark the fulfillment as shipped">
    In the **Fulfillment** section, open the actions menu for the fulfillment and choose **Mark as shipped**. Add any tracking numbers, then confirm. Shipping is available only after the items have been fulfilled.
  </Step>
</Steps>
